name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: U.S. citizen departs Iran after being barred from leaving for over a year
changes.summary: A U.S.-Iranian woman who was trapped in Iran on allegations of espionage and collaborating with a hostile state that her attorney called "bogus" has departed the country, CBS News learned Wednesday.

changes.title: U.S. to impose 25% tariffs on Brazilian imports over unfair trade practices, White House says
changes.summary: The United States is imposing 25% tariffs on imports from Brazil after finding a range of what it deemed unfair trade practices by the world.

changes.title: U.S., Iran in a "new phase" of the conflict, retired Navy vice admiral explains
changes.summary: U.S. Central Command confirmed it began a second wave of strikes against Iran on Wednesday, following a round of attacks earlier in the day. Retired Navy Vice Adm. Robert Murrett joins CBS News to discuss.

changes.title: Wildfires expose millions in Midwest, Northeast to dangerous smoke
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and Northeast U.S. this week.

changes.title: Trump Administration to Impose New Tariffs on Brazil
changes.summary: The United States accused the country of unfair trade practices. The tariff will replace ones that the Supreme Court struck down.

changes.title: Trump Flip-Flops on Strait of Hormuz Plan, and U.S. Cyclospora Outbreak Spreads
changes.summary: Plus, Chipotle is coming to Mexico.

changes.title: Erica Schwartz testifies in confirmation hearing for CDC director
changes.summary: Schwartz told the Senate health committee she "will never betray the science" and pledged to use "radical transparency" in a bid to rebuild public trust in the agency. But several senators questioned how she might handle pressure from Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who has repeatedly moved to alter U.S. vaccin.

changes.title: Senators Grill Justice Dept. Officials on New York Times Subpoenas
changes.summary: Democrats questioned the acting attorney general, Todd Blanche, and a U.S. attorney about subpoenas issued to Times journalists who reported on security concerns with the president’s new plane.

changes.title: Fear and hope in Utah in the shadow of America's largest wildfire
changes.summary: People in Monticello, Utah have been tense and preparing to evacuate since shortly after the Babylon fire started June 26th (Image credit: Inciweb).
